question: May direct-CDP browser screenshot capture intentionally leave the captured tab foregrounded in multi-tab sessions?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and proven, but foregrounding is an observable browser-session compatibility contract that should be owned by a human maintainer before merge.

options.title: Accept Screenshot Foregrounding
options.body: Merge with the documented behavior that direct-CDP screenshots activate the captured target tab to avoid background-capture stalls.

options.title: Require Prior-Tab Restoration
options.body: Ask for a focused follow-up that records and restores the previously active target when reliable, with failure coverage.

options.title: Keep Screenshots Non-Mutating
options.body: Pause this approach if browser inspection commands must not alter foreground tab state.

recommendation.title: Accept Screenshot Foregrounding
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented behavior that direct-CDP screenshots activate the captured target tab to avoid background-capture stalls.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored this replacement PR and has the strongest current browser/CDP routing history among the likely owners.
